hypothesis: A-share low absolute 60-session volatility associated with higher next 20 joint-session post-cost stock returns than same-day sampled-eligible equal-weight stock benchmark. NOT prior rv10/rv60 ratio.
external_prior: Blitz, Hanauer, van Vliet (2021), The Volatility Effect in China, DOI 10.1057/s41260-021-00218-0

sample.selection_by_hash: SHA256(seed+'|'+canonical_id) ascending, first 128 PIT members; no future delisting selection
sample.scope: Each year's separate 128 membership cohort, not whole A-share market; 2023/24 identity overlap permitted

date_policy.signal_dates: First actual joint BaoStock A-share trading session of each calendar month Apr-Dec in 2023 and Jan-Nov in 2024 (20 dates)
date_policy.factor_window_last_60_daily_returns: Exactly 61 consecutive A-share joint sessions ending on D, from returned 2022-08-01 onward

signal.feature: Sample standard deviation (ddof=0) of the 60 daily log returns of adjusted closing prices, only information through session D
signal.status: valid positive adjusted closes for all 61 consecutive sessions and active non-ST positive-volume bar on D
signal.rank: ascending absolute 60-session volatility, tie ascending canonical security_id
signal.select: bottom ceil(25% of eligible same-day sample), require >=40 eligible same-day stocks

outcome.entry: Adjusted open of D+1 joint session (signal computed AFTER D close)
outcome.exit: Adjusted close of D+20 joint session
outcome.missing_or_ST_at_entry_or_exit: Keep selected security identity and mark unresolved; never filter the selection using D+1 or D+20 information
outcome.raw_vendor_adjustflag: 2 adjusted by 2026 vendor vintage, not certified point-in-time corporate actions
outcome.market_index: sh.000300 retrospective PRICE index, D+1 open to D+20 close
outcome.primary: equal-month selected net average minus same-month signal-eligible equal-weight net average with same 30bp cost; report versus CSI300 price index as secondary

decision.supported_descriptively_only_if: Primary equal-month selection-minus-universe mean > 0, both 2023 and 2024 year mean > 0, at least 60% of months individually positive; otherwise UNSUPPORTED
